source.quote: From a marketplace install `fleet doctor` failed with `pluginRoot is required`: installed plugins live at `<cache>/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/`, so the repo-layout sibling default never resolved. The default now also looks for the highest manifest-bearing version directory beside fleet.

prompt: Write resolve-root.js in the current directory, exporting resolvePluginRoot(fleetDir) with CommonJS. fleetDir is <cache>/<marketplace>/fleet/<version>. Return the path of the highest version directory of the sibling plugin <cache>/<marketplace>/agentic-work-packages/<version> that contains .claude-plugin/plugin.json. Compare versions numerically per dot-separated part (1.4.10 is higher than 1.4.9). Ignore version directories without that manifest. If none qualifies, throw an Error. Reply with the single word done.
